Gate A, Gate B (all 8 TPC-H tables, all 24 TPC-DS tables, and all 6 derived benchmarks), and Gate D pass on the pinned tpcgen-cli version across all supported CI platforms.

context: Phase 3 Tier 1 cutover of the faster data-generation plan. Separated from Tier 3/SSB cutover and legacy retirement so validated TPC-H/TPC-DS cutover and Owner Decision A2 (Parquet layout default) can land independently.
description:
## Problem
After Phase 1 proves tpcgen-cli parity for TPC-H and TPC-DS behind opt-in --datagen-backend native, defaults cannot safely flip until corpus provenance hashing (bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus) is fixed and the deferred published-run Parquet layout decision (owner decision A2) is settled with measured validation evidence.

## Change
- Verify bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus is done and Gate A, Gate B, and Gate D are green on the pinned tpcgen-cli version across every supported CI platform.
- Present the measured Parquet layout and query-timing comparison (streaming BaseFormatConverter vs direct tpcgen-cli Parquet on DuckDB, DataFusion, Polars) to the owner to settle the published-run Parquet default (owner decision A2), and record the outcome in docs/internal/adr/adr-benchbox-datagen.md.
- Flip tpch and tpcds in benchbox/utils/datagen_backend.py's default table per the ADR's optional-extra default rule (keeping Windows arm64 and TPC-H/TPC-DS refresh paths routed cleanly to bundled C binaries).
- Retain --datagen-backend legacy as a fully tested escape hatch and add a changelog.d/ fragment ([CHANGELOG-001]).

## Decision gates
- Hard blocked on bundle-data-generation-hash-missing-from-corpus closing.
- Hard stop for explicit owner sign-off on published-run Parquet layout default (A2: keep BenchBox streaming converter as default vs adopt direct tpcgen-cli Parquet with a documented re-baseline) before changing Parquet default behavior.

## Guardrails
- Never promote tpcgen-cli to a required dependency of core benchbox (conflicts with adr-python-core-runtime.md).
- Never remove --datagen-backend legacy or any binary from benchbox/_binaries/ in this item (at least one minor release retention is required before retirement).
- Never break Windows arm64 or TPC-H/TPC-DS refresh streams.
- Follow AGENTS.md ([CHANGELOG-001], [COMMENT-POLICY-001], linked worktree, make pr-preflight, merged PR).
